description.value: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver-area cafe chain established in 1996, known for its in-house roasted organic coffee and award-winning homemade New York-style cheesecakes. This Capstan (Richmond) location offers coffee, tea, sandwiches, salads, soups, and baked goods. With 14 locations across greater Vancouver, Trees also hosts live music events and offers online ordering with in-store pickup and delivery.
